en: Vintage black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard showing a street scene with Hartmann's Restaurant in Meissen. Large trees partially hide an outdoor garden restaurant terrace filled with people. Adjacent multi‑storey buildings carry painted advertisements including "Säuberlichs Restaurant." Cobblestone streets with several pedestrians in early 20th‑century attire run alongside the buildings. Printed red caption text at the top identifies the location and restaurant, and red publisher text appears at the bottom left.
